title: The master loop runs its next cycle as soon as another actor records an event
description: The command step runs the loop against a ledger on a long interval: a submission or verdict starts a cycle within seconds, a burst is one cycle, and with no events the interval still applies; the HTTP step reads the newest-first event feed the loop polls.

steps.name: the loop wakes on a ledger event and coalesces a burst
the event feed the loop polls answers newest first
